class.name: IvyMeshBuilder
class.brief_description: Decoupled Layer 2 builder converting ivy growth graphs into 3D stem meshes and leaf transforms.
class.description: [IvyMeshBuilder] consumes the pure topological graph arrays produced by [IvyGenerator] ([method IvyGenerator.get_point_positions], [method IvyGenerator.get_point_thicknesses], and [method IvyGenerator.get_point_parent_indices]) without making any material or gameplay assumptions. [method build_stem_mesh] generates a smooth, tapered cylindrical [ArrayMesh] with twist-free ring frames, wall-adhesion offset, seam-free UVs, Godot clockwise front-face winding, and optional tapered tip caps. It populates [constant Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR], and [constant Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]. Semantic vertex color channels encode: [code]R[/code] = normalized thickness ([code]thickness / max_thickness[/code]), [code]G[/code] = normalized progress along the stem chain ([code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]), [code]B[/code] = normalized branch order ([code]clamp(branch_order / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)[/code]), and [code]A = 1.0[/code]. [method build_leaf_transforms] generates deterministic [Transform3D] placements ready for a [MultiMeshInstance3D], using the local convention: origin at the petiole attachment point on the stem surface, [code]-Z[/code] pointing toward the blade tip, and [code]+Y[/code] as the upper leaf face normal.

method.name: build_leaf_transforms
method.description: Generates deterministic 3D leaf placement transforms along living stem chains using [member settings]. Returns an empty array if [member settings] is null, if the graph arrays or [param wall_normal] are invalid, or if [member IvyMeshSettings.leaf_density] is [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: build_stem_mesh
method.description: Builds a tapered 3D cylindrical stem [ArrayMesh] from the supplied growth graph arrays and [param wall_normal] using [member settings]. Returns [code]null[/code] if [member settings] is null or if any input array, thickness, parent index, or [param wall_normal] fails validation. Isolated single-root graphs with no segments return a valid empty [ArrayMesh].

members.member: The [IvyMeshSettings] resource controlling stem tessellation, wall offset, UV scaling, and deterministic leaf placement.
